fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the execution of format.com with an uncommon filesystem selection that could indicate a defense evasion activity in which "format.com" is used to load malicious DLL files or other programs.
fields.name: Uncommon FileSystem Load Attempt By Format.com
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\format.com" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "/fs:") and (not (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/fs:exFAT" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/fs:FAT" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/fs:NTFS" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/fs:ReFS" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/fs:UDF"))))
